name: Glory
overview: Scripture reveals the glory of God as a magnificent display of His power, holiness, and greatness, evident in His mighty acts such as triumphing over enemies and proclaiming His name (Exodus 15:1,6,11; Exodus 34:5). The people of God have witnessed His glory firsthand, hearing His voice and seeing His presence, which confirms that God truly communicates with His people and lives among them (Deuteronomy 5:24). This glory is both glorious and fearful, underscoring the reverence due to the LORD, the one true God (Deuteronomy 28:58).
